title: No Tamed Suffocation
description: Prevents tamed mobs from taking suffocation damage inside blocks.
body:
No Tamed Suffocation prevents tamed mobs from taking suffocation damage when they get stuck inside blocks.

It is useful for pets, mounts, and modded tameable creatures that can sometimes clip into walls, ceilings, trees, or other blocks.

The mod only blocks suffocation damage for tamed entities. It does not make them immortal and does not prevent other types of damage.
